selection.eligible: Exactly two reference annotator sets; nonempty source; no source duplicate inside selected packet.

strata.rule: Source contains >=1 protected token under frozen regex families.
strata.selection: 16 lowest SHA256(normalized source bytes || salt || K1) among eligible K1 rows.

strata.rule: Source contains zero protected tokens under K1 regex families.
strata.selection: 16 lowest SHA256(normalized source bytes || salt || K2) among eligible K2 rows.

selection.normalization: NONE for scientific text; selection hash uses raw decoded source string exactly.

hidden_gold.reveal_stage: Only after A0-A3 outputs/selections are frozen.
hidden_gold.use: Diagnostic reference-set proximity and exact human-reference hit only; never writing-quality authority.

prompt.instruction: Correct only what is necessary in the Korean sentence while preserving meaning and factual/reference content. Return only the revised sentence. If no correction is needed, return the original sentence unchanged.

legality.K2_authority: FORMAT_ONLY; no invented semantic legality oracle.

learned_ranking.score: length-normalized conditional log probability under frozen generator

P: reference-set exact hit as diagnostic only
C: whether multiple human references remain reachable in candidate set diagnostically
R: character/word edit distance to nearest human reference as proxy only

primary_contrast: A1 vs A3 on identical K=4 candidate pools
promotion_rule: A3 must improve at least one authority-bearing P/A coordinate without worsening P hard gates; reference proximity alone cannot promote better writing.
